Bridge4PS is a secure mobile and desktop communications and data sharing app designed specifically for first responders to communicate in real-time across teams, departments, agencies, and jurisdictions

Bridge4PS is the outcome of the Department of Homeland Security-sponsored Mobility Acceleration Coalition of early mobile public safety technology adopters in Houston, Texas, and Los Angeles, California led by Mobility 4 Public Safety.

Bridge4PS is an exclusive public safety communications platform that provides messaging and collaboration features tailored to the unique requirements of first responders. Bridge4PS offers free and secure cloud-based capabilities to bridge a variety of public safety communications
